title: Software Engineer
teaser: Become part of our team as a Software Engineer, contributing to the design and delivery of AI-driven backend systems for Cisco IQ. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to build scalable, data-integrated solutions. Ideal for candidates with strong Python and backend development expertise, and experience in AI, cloud, and data integration.
description:
About the Role

Join our Backend Team to design and deliver the AI-driven backbone of Cisco IQ.

You will work across multiple stacks and domains to build data-intensive integrations and scalable features that power the next generation of Cisco's global platform.
 

Meet the Team

At Cisco, we believe technology has the power to connect, empower, and move us forward. The AAA (Automation and Advanced Analytics) team drives highly visible transformation initiatives, including acquired company integrations and modern platform evolution. The Engineering team within AAA builds cloud-native and AI-driven capabilities that help customers and partners realize value faster through a unified Cisco experience.

Your Impact

In this role, you will design and build scalable backend systems, AI-enabled services, and data pipelines that transform raw data into actionable insights. You will help productionize AI solutions, optimize performance, and ensure high standards of reliability, data quality, and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with product owners and engineers to align solution designs with business goals and architecture principles.

Translate product requirements into scalable technical solutions and implementation plans.

Build and maintain robust backend services, APIs, and AI-enabled application engines.

Design and optimize ETL/ELT workflows for ingestion, transformation, validation, and enrichment of diverse datasets.

Develop and operationalize AI/ML and LLM-based capabilities, including agentic workflows and prompt-driven automation.

Design and deploy LangGraph-based workflows for reliable orchestration, tool routing, and stateful execution in production.

Build and maintain multi-agent architectures with clear role boundaries, handoff protocols, and guardrails.

Establish software and system design standards, quality gates, and engineering best practices.

Deliver end-to-end solutions with strong observability, performance, and security.

Create technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and stakeholder presentations for technical and non-technical audiences.

Minimum Qualifications

Strong hands-on experience with Python and backend development.

Experience with FastAPI, Flask, or similar Python frameworks.

Hands-on experience with RAG, LLM applications and Agentic AI, preferably LangGraph.

Strong knowledge of SQL/PostgreSQL and REST/GraphQL APIs.

Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree with 3 years of related experience.

Experience with enterprise CI/CD and DevOps practices.

Familiarity with networking fundamentals and distributed systems.

Experience working in Agile development environments.

Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder communication.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

begin with screening or an interview

originate from a Cisco email address, and

be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

 

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.
